needs_review.name: ISI /team/ namespace — role not stated in snippet
needs_review.question: ISI's own text describes a Campus Director leading "staff, ministry Reps and volunteers", and /team/ is a single namespace. For records whose snippet gave no explicit role (Sue Johnston, Wendy Moynihan, Anne Adrian, Jeff Townsend, Jessica Wang, Samuel and Joanne Carroll, Simon and Becky Zeigler, Chris and Kelly Rowley), role was taken from the /team/ Campus Staff Archive namespace rather than from page text. None were identified as a volunteer or ministry Rep, so rule 6 did not trigger, but the role attribution is namespace-level.
needs_review.notes: Confirm role per page at ingest. Page fetching was blocked, so only titles, URLs and snippets were available.

needs_review.name: Dawn Dorning / Brett and Roberta LaShelle — city ambiguity
needs_review.question: A single result set named Campus Directors in Madison, WI and Bozeman, MT without tying either city to a specific profile. Which city belongs to which person could not be determined.
needs_review.notes: city and state deliberately left blank on both records rather than guessed. Records themselves are sound and were emitted.

needs_review.name: City Directors with unresolved cities
needs_review.question: One result set listed City Directors for Boston, Seattle, Lenexa KS, Charlottesville VA, Portland, Bloomington IN, Fort Collins CO, Boise ID, Colorado Springs CO and Buffalo NY without mapping each city to a profile. Tim Weston, Carol Douglass, Kimberly Daniel, Jeff Newpher, the Bergers, Babcocks, Dunnes and Bevans could not be located.
needs_review.notes: Emitted with city and state blank. Only Hope (Boston), Flynn (Charlottesville) and Kuechle (Buffalo) were explicitly tied to a city in snippet text.

needs_review.question: Directory page titled "Staff and Volunteers", i.e. the volunteer population ISI mixes with staff. Excluded under rule 1 as a directory and never mined.
